functionalRequirement: For any systematic action, such as disputes aging process, a case activity will be generated, and the user who initiated the dispute case must be notified upon next logon.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must generate and track case activities for 100% of systematic actions related to dispute processes.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures comprehensive logging and tracking of all dispute-related activities

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The notification system must have 99.9% uptime to ensure users are consistently informed about case activities.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Critical for maintaining user awareness of dispute status

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: The notification mechanism must clearly display the case activity details, including case number, status, and relevant actions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides clear communication to users about their dispute process

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: Notification content must be encrypted and only accessible to the authenticated user who initiated the dispute.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Protects sensitive information related to dispute cases

functionalRequirement: System shall read initialization data to derive definitions of heating and cooling units.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must accurately interpret 100% of initialization data for heating and cooling unit definitions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures precise interpretation of critical system configuration data

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The initialization data reading process must complete within 500 milliseconds for complex unit configurations.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Minimizes system startup time and ensures quick configuration

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Fault Tolerance: The system must have a fallback mechanism to use default unit definitions if initialization data is corrupted or unreadable.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Prevents system failure due to configuration data issues

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Analysability: The system must log all initialization data reading processes with detailed error and success messages for troubleshooting.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Supports easy diagnosis of configuration-related issues

functionalRequirement: The website shall provide forms for certificates so users can request certificates online.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Learnability: The certificate request form must have a clear, intuitive interface with maximum 5 steps to complete a request.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures users can easily navigate and complete certificate requests

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must support all required certificate types with unique, specific request forms.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides comprehensive coverage of certificate request needs

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Authenticity: The certificate request form must implement multi-factor authentication to verify user identity before submission.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Prevents unauthorized certificate requests

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The certificate request form must load within 2 seconds and submit within 3 seconds under normal network conditions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures responsive and efficient user experience

functionalRequirement: User shall be able to manage privacy settings such as who can view their profile, connections, and sharing data with third parties.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: All privacy settings must be encrypted at rest and in transit using AES-256 encryption.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Protects sensitive user privacy configuration data

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: Privacy settings interface must provide clear, granular controls with real-time preview of visibility changes.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Enables users to easily understand and modify their privacy preferences

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must support privacy controls for at least 5 different visibility levels (e.g., public, friends only, specific groups, connections, private).
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides comprehensive privacy management options

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Recoverability: The system must maintain a 30-day history of privacy setting changes with ability to revert to previous configurations.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Allows users to track and restore previous privacy settings

functionalRequirement: System shall set over temperature values to prevent temperature deviations beyond 3 degrees Fahrenheit.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Fault Tolerance: The system must automatically trigger an alert if temperature deviations exceed the 3-degree Fahrenheit threshold.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures immediate notification of potential temperature control issues

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: Temperature monitoring and deviation detection must occur with a maximum latency of 100 milliseconds.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides real-time temperature control and monitoring

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operational Constraint: The temperature control system must have a manual override mechanism for emergency temperature adjustments.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides critical safety control in exceptional circumstances

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: Temperature measurements must be accurate within ±0.5 degrees Fahrenheit of the actual temperature.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures precise temperature monitoring and control
